newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's forint closes slightly softer vs dlr.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's forint closes slightly softer vs dlr.

text.p: The Hungarian forint tracked dollar/mark's movements in Europe and finished Tuesday trading a shade weaker against the dollar, dealers said.
The forint closed at 154.82/86, compared with its opening of 154.68/71 and 154.79/82 at noon.
"It was a very calm day," said Gabor Butor of Unicbank. "The forint followed the dollar/mark in a narrow range."
On the currency futures market of the Budapest Commodity Exchange, the Swiss franc, the dollar and the Ecu shared most of the moderate turnover of 3.5 billion forints.
